sessions.title: What happens when I answer honestly
sessions.focus: The therapist explains confidentiality and asks directly about current suicidal thoughts, intent, access, and supports.
sessions.possible_movement: Keisha corrects an assumption and participates in updating the safety plan.
sessions.carry_forward: Confirm follow-up contacts and immediate needs.

sessions.title: The first night back
sessions.focus: Sleep, meals, medication questions, and temporary housing are reviewed alongside risk.
sessions.possible_movement: Keisha chooses two realistic anchors rather than a full recovery schedule.
sessions.carry_forward: Coordinate with the prescriber as authorized.

sessions.title: The hour that stretches
sessions.focus: Evening isolation is identified as a predictable period of increased passive thoughts.
sessions.possible_movement: She rehearses contacting her cousin before the intensity peaks.

sessions.title: Shame in the waiting room
sessions.focus: Keisha worries coworkers and family now see her as fragile.
sessions.possible_movement: The therapist separates privacy choices from secrecy driven by shame.
sessions.carry_forward: Choose what, if anything, to share at work.

sessions.title: Returning for four hours
sessions.focus: A limited work shift brings competence and exhaustion.
sessions.possible_movement: Keisha notices warning signs before pushing through them.

sessions.title: The difficult Tuesday
sessions.focus: A housing setback and poor sleep bring back stronger suicidal thoughts without current intent.
sessions.possible_movement: She tells the therapist and uses supports; the session reassesses safety directly.

sessions.title: Anger at being watched
sessions.focus: Keisha resents check-ins from loved ones and wants more privacy.
sessions.possible_movement: She negotiates a support plan that includes boundaries and clear escalation signals.
sessions.carry_forward: Share the revised plan with consent.

sessions.title: The story she is not ready to tell
sessions.focus: They approach the crisis without demanding a full narrative.
sessions.possible_movement: Keisha identifies one point where options felt invisible and one point where connection returned.

sessions.title: A plan for the next accumulation
sessions.focus: They map combinations of stressors rather than a single trigger.
sessions.possible_movement: Keisha identifies earlier thresholds for sleep, isolation, and hopelessness.
sessions.carry_forward: Add thresholds to the safety plan.

sessions.title: Continuing care without a finish line
sessions.focus: The arc reviews current risk, supports, work, housing, and unresolved grief.
sessions.possible_movement: Keisha defines stability as earlier response and more choice, not absence of difficult thoughts forever.
